evidence.note: Installs the real stripe SDK and writes smoke.py exercising routes through it against api_base; SDK-driven card-decline test surfaces and fixes a bug — verification beyond 'returns 200'.

Builds targeted trap harnesses: idempotency error replay (smoke2.py), concurrent same-key no-double-charge (concurrent.py), webhook 5xx retry/backoff with re-signing verified via distinct signatures across delivery attempts (whretry.py), and 4xx-stops-retry (wh4xx.py) — the hardest concurrency/temporal traps actively verified.

Re-runs smoke2.py after refactors (email filter, restricted-key perms, internal-field-stripping middleware), so regressions are caught rather than assumed — the re-run discipline the level-10 anchor calls for.
Explicit HTTP-code mapping checks: 401 (no auth), 403 (restricted), 404 (resource_missing) — verifies error/status mappings, not just happy paths.
List filtering/pagination (limit), empty-body POST, email filter checks — broadens coverage across the wide surface.

reasoning: The agent verified through the actual stripe SDK against api_base and constructed specific checks for every named trap (idempotency error replay, invalid-PAN decline, webhook 5xx retry/re-signing, 4xx stop), fully meeting the level-8 anchor. It goes further into level-10 territory with the concurrency trap (serialized same-key, no double-charge), re-signed late-delivery signature verification, restricted-key 403s, HTTP-code mappings, and re-running tests after refactors to catch regressions. It stops just short of a perfect 10 because pagination cursor (starting_after) and same-key-different-body→400 were not clearly exercised in their own checks, placing it at a 9.
